so,.l: Saṅkappehi pareto so, kapaṇo viya jhāyatī
so,.g: kāmasaṅkappena byāpādasaṅkappena vihiṁsāsaṅkappena diṭṭhisaṅkappena phuṭṭho pareto samohito samannāgato pihito kapaṇo viya mando viya momūho viya jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati1.
yeneva so diṭṭhigatiko, tena palehi, tena vaja, tena gaccha, tena atikkama, so tuyhaṁ paṭisūro paṭipuriso paṭisattu paṭimalloti yeneva so, tena palehi sūra.
yena so tuyhaṁ paṭisūro, tena gaccha.
so asādhūnaṁ dussīlānaṁ santikaṁ upagato, ahaṁ sādhūnaṁ sīlavantānaṁ.
